description: Zero-result response for an UNPINNED record_search (no collectionId) for the tree's given name 'Unna' with the full surname 'Halsteinsdatter'. research_log_append refuses a zero-hit search pinned to one collection until the same names are also searched without the collection (research-log-editor-spec.md section 8.5), so the pinned 'Unna Halsteinsdatter' nil in collection 1468080 forces this retry. Captured live with recordCountry Norway, which returns zero; a live check on 2026-11-16 without recordCountry returned 502 fuzzy matches, none of them the 1786 Hamre marriage. Keyed on givenName 'Unna': a live search with the given name 'Urna' and the full surname finds the record (2026-11-16), so this answer does not apply to it. The predicate cannot require collectionId to be absent; it only ever sees unpinned calls because it is listed after the collection-1468080 fixtures that answer every pinned call first.
